HPQCD_tableI_eq15.interpretation: Remove the exact central reference Wilson coefficient. The 6% working width of the integrated hadronic rate includes the approximately 5% form-factor uncertainty and charged lifetime; the removed CKM and loop errors do not re-enter.

run3_scope: LHCb 2024-25 sample separately refitted at A_DG=+1,0,-1. The 0.78 minimum of the full prompt-to-selected light/heavy weight over the rate box is a transfer assumption, not an exact likelihood or a measurement for the Run 1-3 combination.
mu_rate_transfer_role: Fixed multiplicative rate budget for residual local matching/photon convention, not a bound on arbitrary nonlocal amplitudes. Kept at 2% at both experimental widths.
experimental_units: Absolute branching fractions, with fixed Belle II display conversion 4.97e-6 per unit signal strength.
treatment: Real positive ratio k required incl common phase; input widths are marginal working rectangles, without confidence interpretation. Positive scalar rate allowed, no unbounded coherent pseudoscalar or extra invisible source.
